def test_add():
    db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE t (v)')
    db.execute('INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)')
    assert db.execute('SELECT SUM(v) FROM t').fetchone()[0] == 1

def test_sum_empty():
    db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE t (v)')
    assert db.execute('SELECT SUM(v) FROM t').fetchone()[0] is None

Refactor this code by merging the two sort functions that differ only in their key:

def by_date(rows):
    copy = list(rows)
    copy.sort(key=lambda r: r['ts'])
    return copy

def by_name(rows):
    copy = list(rows)
    copy.sort(key=lambda r: r['name'].lower())
    return copy
